workers.name: telemetry-dispatch
workers.trigger: event: job enqueued per outbox row by TrackBrowserTelemetryEventUseCase and webhooks route (purchase-dispatch)
workers.whatItDoes: Loads the outbox_events row by id (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), dispatches payload via TelemetryDispatchService, marks status=sent or records retry with attempt_count/last_error

workers.name: webhook-retries
workers.trigger: event (consumer registered; no active producer found in src)
workers.whatItDoes: Re-runs RecordPaymentWebhookUseCase for a payment webhook payload; throws to trigger BullMQ retry on failure

workers.name: email-jobs
workers.trigger: event: enqueued by DrizzlePaymentRepository after payment outbox insert
workers.whatItDoes: Kicks ProcessOutboxBatchUseCase to drain pending notification outbox events

workers.name: recommendation-processing
workers.trigger: event (consumer registered; no active producer found in src)
workers.whatItDoes: Persists a RecommendationEvent from job payload via the recommendation events repository

workers.name: analytics-fanout
workers.whatItDoes: Runs SyntheticMonitor every 5 min and RecommendationMaterializer hourly, branching on job.name

workerRegistration.entryPoint: apps/api/src/interfaces/http/server.ts calls startOutboxTicker() + registerAllWorkers() at boot
workerRegistration.backpressure: QueueService 10s monitor scales concurrency 5->2->1 when avg DB latency >250/500ms or event-loop lag >50/100ms

leasing.claim: claimDueBatch in one short tx; completion compare-and-sets on worker_id so an expired-lease worker writes nothing

ORDER_*_checkout_side_effects: infrastructure/db/repositories/DrizzleCheckoutSideEffectRecorder.ts (also mirrors to checkout_side_effects table; types in application/ports/ICheckoutSideEffectRecorder.ts)

outbox.processingSplit: ProcessOutboxBatchUseCase excludes CHECKOUT_SIDE_EFFECT_EVENT_TYPES; ProcessCheckoutSideEffectBatchUseCase claims only those; TelemetryDispatchService claims only TELEMETRY_DISPATCH

schedulers.name: OutboxTicker
schedulers.trigger: setInterval 30s with <=5s startup jitter (disabled by DISABLE_OUTBOX_PROCESSOR=1)
schedulers.whatItDoes: Each tick concurrently runs notification outbox batch, telemetry dispatch batch, and checkout side-effect batch via Promise.allSettled (isolated failure domains, single isProcessing overlap guard, graceful drain on shutdown)

schedulers.name: SyntheticMonitor
schedulers.trigger: BullMQ repeat cron '*/5 * * * *' on analytics-fanout (job synthetic-cron)
schedulers.whatItDoes: Independent DB-truth vs public-API catalogue parity and synthetic commerce check; emits Prometheus metrics with CATALOGUE_* reason codes

schedulers.name: RecommendationMaterializer
schedulers.trigger: BullMQ repeat cron '0 * * * *' on analytics-fanout (job recommendation-materialize-cron)
schedulers.whatItDoes: Pre-computes cached recommendations (home_trending, cart_addon, per-category) and prunes telemetry_dlq rows older than 30 days

schedulers.name: QueueServiceBackpressureMonitor
schedulers.whatItDoes: Adjusts all BullMQ worker concurrency (5/2/1) from avg DB query latency and event-loop lag

outboxDeadLetter.policy: ProcessOutboxBatchUseCase: MAX_ATTEMPTS=8, exponential backoff capped at 3600s, then markDeadLettered; ProcessCheckoutSideEffectBatchUseCase: MAX_ATTEMPTS=8 plus immediate dead-letter on permanent errors (e.g. MISSING_ORDER_REFERENCE)

telemetryDlq.policy: TelemetryDispatchService: MAX_ATTEMPTS=5, backoff 30s->5m->15m->1h->6h then DLQ write attempted before marking outbox row processed (row stays in outbox if DLQ write fails)

bullmq.policy: removeOnFail:false retains failed jobs in Redis; QueueService.replayFailedJobs(queueName) re-drives them; stalled jobs fail after 3 stalls at 15s detection interval
